hypothesis: Bounded scan and rollback repairs preserve the local contract while closing reproduced failures.
exact_modification: Bound directory/glob enumeration and prune excluded/link paths
Reject linked ignore/output paths and non-file artifact targets
Preserve recovery backups on rollback failure
Pin evaluator bytes and denominator, independently validate case identity and results
Bind ledgers to execution-time source/evaluator/test hashes; persist rejected trials
Refuse redirected model requests and repeat tool calls; quarantine live compatibility
Add checkout normalization, README and Windows CI
intended_mechanism: Enforce existing boundaries before traversal or mutation and prevent invalid or stale evidence from passing adjudication.
adversarial_results: Frozen adversarial cases passed in both runs; added regressions cover scan limits, overlapping selectors, linked paths, directory targets, failed rollback, duplicate cases, forged results, stale evidence and rejected-trial persistence.
cost_results: Declared fixture budgets passed; no live-provider expenditure or broad performance improvement claim.

safety_results.scope: Trusted nonconcurrent local workspace; cooperative deadlines, no OS sandbox guarantee

decision_rationale: Accept local branch preparation and bounded repairs only. Full repository checks passed and independent review reported no remaining merge blockers. Live compatibility is quarantined.
reproducibility_notes: Python 3.12 on Windows. Both 24-case runs have identical case decisions and safety findings. Exact source hashes and commands are in acceptance-final.json.
rollback_trigger: Any accepted contract, safety or regression check fails; revert the branch commit and preserve failed-rollback .bak files for recovery.

operator_notes.independent_review: Proposer/executor and separate reviewer outputs reconciled; final reviewer found no remaining blockers
operator_notes.unrelated_work: Council execution, handoffs, goal-control and harness context snapshots preserved and excluded locally
